authority: Darren approved execution and cumulative integration. Production deployment, new credentials, PyPI publication, and Cloud propagation remain prohibited.
evidence_contract: Bind to the exact cumulative base and candidate SHA; preserve fault-injection logs, restart/reconnect evidence, transaction ordering, retention measurements, independent tests, and rollback ref.
title: Implement authoritative durable capability state
problem: The current capability contract proves ordering only with a synthetic in-memory store.
outcome: The authoritative path provides durable, atomic, recoverable capability state.
hard_constraints: Forced failures must not expose uncommitted state.
Use disposable test state; no operator databases or credentials.

stories.title: Implement persistent store
stories.description: Replace the authoritative in-memory path with a persistent implementation and atomic transaction boundary.

stories.title: Implement recovery semantics
stories.description: Add reconnect/refetch, crash recovery, and bounded retention behavior.

stories.title: Prove failure ordering
stories.description: Run deterministic fault injection and independent restart tests.

acceptance: Atomic commit and notification ordering are proven under injected failure.
Retention windows and expiry are tested.
Synthetic fixtures are not counted as real durability evidence.
verification: Run persistent-backend tests, crash/reconnect/fault matrix, and independent clean-export adjudication.
rollback: Disable the durable path behind the existing default-off boundary and restore the prior receipt; preserve failure evidence.
success_metrics: durable backend active in acceptance path
